data.title: Head Chef
data.summary: The head chef runs a restaurant and catering kitchen, leads a small team, and oversees lunch service. The role also involves developing the lunch and catering offering.

requirements.text: At least 3 years as a head chef or shift manager in Finland
requirements.question: Would someone who has done head chef or shift manager work, with fewer than 3 years, be worth a conversation?
requirements.why: The posting requires prior head chef or shift manager experience gained over a set period in Finland.

requirements.text: Ability to independently lead a kitchen and a small team
Passion for kitchen work and hands-on cooking
requirements.question: What does 'passion for kitchen work and hands-on cooking' look like in this job? One concrete example helps us find people who have done it.
requirements.why: The posting emphasises passion for hands-on kitchen work rather than computer-based work.

requirements.text: Skill in making tasty homemade food with fresh ingredients
Developmental leadership and the ability to inspire others
requirements.question: What does 'developmental leadership' look like in this job? One concrete example helps us find people who have done it.
requirements.why: The posting names developmental leadership as a strength without describing the expected behaviour.

requirements.text: Broad professional expertise to develop the business and team
requirements.question: What does 'broad professional expertise' look like in this job? One concrete example helps us find people who have done it.
requirements.why: The posting asks for broad professional expertise without specifying the most relevant areas.
